title: H3Africa: African-led genomics capacity, ethics, and data-infrastructure rail
summary: Infrastructure record for H3Africa as a capacity-and-governance rail: not merely more samples, but African-led research infrastructure, training, biobanking, ethical guidelines, and disease/environment studies.

status_history.note: Added to prevent denominator diversity from being reduced to sample-count extraction without governance/capacity.

place.scope: African continent genomics research infrastructure and capacity; not a single dataset record

subjects.name: Human Heredity and Health in Africa (H3Africa)

claims.claim: NIH Fogarty describes H3Africa as a partnership between NIH, the African Society of Human Genetics, and Wellcome/AESA, facilitating disease research on the African continent while developing infrastructure, resources, training, and ethical guidelines for a sustainable African research enterprise led by African scientists for African people.
